speak.title: Role-play: a skeleton for the museum
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your museum is short of money. You want the new owner to lend the skeleton to the museum for a few years. Explain why the public and scientists need to see it. Ask for a promise.

b.text: You've just bought the skeleton for $47 million. You'd like to keep it at home, but you might lend it. Ask what the museum can offer you. You can say yes, no, or yes with a condition.

phrases: We'd love to show it to the public.
I paid a lot of money for it, and it's mine.
Scientists can't study it if it's in your house.
What would the museum offer me?
I'd lend it for two years, but only if you put my name on it.
Let's agree on a deal we're both happy with.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the buyer agree to lend the skeleton, and was that fair?
